text:
E hiwere Vancouver na 1886, ọ bụ obodo kasị ukwuu na British Columbia na mpaghara obodo nke atọ kasị ukwuu na Canada — ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri Pacific dị mkpa na ọnụ ụzọ n’ụsọ oké osimiri ọdịda anyanwụ Canada, nke North Shore Mountains na Pacific Ocean gbara ya gburugburu. Ọnọdụ ya n’etiti oké osimiri na ugwu na-enye obodo ahụ njirimara pụrụ iche n’etiti obodo ndị Canada, e nwetakwara ọnọdụ ya dị ka ebe ụwa mgbe ọ bụrụ obodo nnabata nke 2010 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games, nke e mere emume ya na BC Place.

Vancouver nwekwara otu n’ime mgbọrọgwụ soccer kacha miri emi na Canada. Egwuregwu bọọlụ nke otu malitere na British Columbia n’oge mbụ, e guzobere Pacific Coast Association Football League na 1908 ma mee egwuregwu ọkachamara mbụ na 1910. Oge nke oge a nke ihe ịtụnanya bịarutere na Vancouver Whitecaps, ndị wepụtara NASL’s Soccer Bowl na 1979 — mmeri nke dọtara ihe dị ka ndị fan 100,000 na ngagharị mmeri na Robson Street. Usoro ahụ gara n’ihu site na 86ers, aha ya bụ 1886, afọ e hiwere obodo ahụ, ndị bu ụzọ egwuregwu obodo ahụ site na 1980s na 1990s. Eriri ahụ na-aga n’ihu na-enweghị nkwụsị ruo Vancouver Whitecaps FC nke oge a, ndị sonyere MLS na 2011 ma na-egwu egwuregwu ha na BC Place.

Ihe nketa bọọlụ nke obodo ahụ na-agbatị nke ọma karịa klọb ya. Vancouver nabatara 2015 FIFA Women’s World Cup Final na BC Place, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ isi bọọlụ Canada dị mkpa na ebe nnabata dabara adaba na ogbo mba ụwa. Site na mmalite ya dị ka obodo ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri ruo ọrụ ya nke oge a dị ka ụlọ MLS na ebe World Cup, Vancouver na-ejikọta ọdịdị ala Pacific ya na omenala soccer dị ka nke ọ bụla na mba ahụ.
